name: ideo-scrum
description: Design Thinking (IDEO Stanford d.school five-mode) and Scrum Sprint methodology — human-centered design, user research, prototyping, agile project management, sprint planning, backlog refinement.

interface.shortDescription: Design Thinking and Scrum Sprint guidance
interface.longDescription: Four kernels (ideo-kernel, scrum-kernel, sprint-kernel, design-kernel) and four roles (Scrum Master, Designer, Developer, Stakeholder). Every role loads the IDEO and Scrum kernels; the sprint and design kernels load when the work involves a Sprint or a design sprint. IDEO methods form a shared toolbox; designs yield prototypes and findings, while Sprints deliver Increments. Conventions and templates ship with the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan the next Sprint, including its Sprint Goal and scope.
Research whether this idea is worth pursuing and test a prototype.
Help me inspect this Increment and prepare the Sprint Review and Retrospective.
